dedupe_keys.name: batterylife battery life prediction benchmark software

description: BatteryLife is the research authors' Python software for preparing and comparing battery-life prediction models. It contains preprocessing, checking, training and evaluation workflows, including neural baselines and transfer-learning scripts. Inputs are processed cycling histories and life labels; outputs include predicted life and benchmark metrics. The initial publication combined 16 datasets and 990 batteries, while later releases add and correct data. Spatial coverage is laboratory cells, not a geographic grid, with temporal resolution inherited from the source cycling experiments. Code is free under MIT; linked data repositories retain separately stated terms. A limitation is that processed measurements can contain errors, and the maintainers provide curve checks and version corrections, not claiming uniform data quality. The software supports storage degradation and maintenance simulations. PyBaMM (platform-pybamm) offers related physical battery modelling. The KDD 2025 paper documents the benchmark; no battery measurements were downloaded.
name: BatteryLife battery-life prediction benchmark software
notes: G7 G7-1118. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
